name: Hrodda Oath-Witness
lore: Hrodda preserves the names of Titans who survive impossible Gate storms. She tests whether a mission objective is worthy of oathbound intervention but never becomes a controllable unit.
personality: Grim, warm only after courage is proven, allergic to excuses.
physicalDescription: Weathered warrior-sage with rune-carved cloak plates, braided iron-gray hair, storm-lit eye scar, and a heavy witness staff.
gameplayFunction: Mission victory witness, oath challenge giver, Asgardian lore unlock source.
